hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts deferred revenue, contract liability, or RPO growth, paired with liquid SPY-relative confirmation, may identify paid-or-contracted demand leaders whose next-open 10-day paper continuation beats generic SEC backlog text and static profitability variants.

prediction.confidence_reason: Backlog/order SEC text variants were too sparse and static Companyfacts profitability variants regressed windows; raw companyfacts contract liabilities and RPO are a materially different PIT demand field with broad raw-cache coverage, but the field is not yet in the selected daily surface and may be noisy across industries.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw companyfacts demand obligation, stale fact, missing prior comparable demand fact, missing annual revenue scaler, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper and selected Companyfacts surface compute the same deferred-revenue/RPO growth gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
